parent_v6.key_refutation: robust-reachable certificate retention was 0.961 while robust-impossible retention was 0.648 under the mixed U0->U2 expansion

scientific_question: Is certificate asymmetry controlled by the direction of world expansion rather than by possibility versus impossibility intrinsically, and how much extra fragility comes from admitting new source hypotheses?

latent_rows.reuse: exact v6 eligible rows and the same 25 percent dispersed positive-occurrence anchors
latent_rows.reference_world_per_source: directed relative_edge_q70 world at the truth row's barrier-density level
latent_rows.baseline_surviving_sources: candidate sources whose reference world survives the frozen positive anchors

candidate_parameter_worlds.for_each_baseline_source: all directed combinations of the three frozen barrier levels and three frozen analyst environmental rules

classification_relative_to_that_source_r.restrictive: candidate reachable set is a strict subset of the reference reachable set
classification_relative_to_that_source_r.permissive: candidate reachable set is a strict superset of the reference reachable set
classification_relative_to_that_source_r.equivalent: candidate reachable set equals the reference reachable set
classification_relative_to_that_source_r.incomparable: neither reachable set contains the other

candidate_parameter_worlds.compatibility: only candidate worlds satisfying the same frozen positive anchors enter an expansion universe

expansion_universes.B0_reference: the surviving reference world for every baseline surviving source
expansion_universes.B_restrictive: B0 plus all compatible restrictive worlds for baseline sources
expansion_universes.B_permissive: B0 plus all compatible permissive worlds for baseline sources
expansion_universes.B_directional_mixed: B0 plus all compatible restrictive and permissive worlds, excluding incomparable worlds
expansion_universes.B_same_source_full: B0 plus all compatible parameter worlds for baseline sources, including incomparable/equivalent worlds
expansion_universes.B_all_source_full: the v6 U2 universe after occurrence conditioning, which additionally admits parameter worlds from sources whose reference world did not survive B0

certificate_population: the exact v6 unobserved locally A/B-permissive node population for the row
primary_outputs: counts of restrictive, permissive, equivalent and incomparable compatible added worlds

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: For every eligible row, every B0 robust-impossible certificate remains robust-impossible under B_restrictive.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any violation is an implementation/theory failure.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: For every eligible row, every B0 robust-reachable certificate remains robust-reachable under B_permissive.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any violation is an implementation/theory failure.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one eligible row loses at least one B0 robust-reachable certificate under B_restrictive.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if restrictive expansion never erodes robust reachability.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one eligible row loses at least one B0 robust-impossible certificate under B_permissive.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if permissive expansion never erodes robust impossibility.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Across the frozen panel, B_directional_mixed erodes at least one robust-reachable and at least one robust-impossible B0 certificate.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED separately if either certificate class never erodes.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one row loses an additional B0 universal certificate when expanding from B_directional_mixed to B_same_source_full.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if incomparable/equivalent additions never create extra certificate loss.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one row loses an additional B0 universal certificate when expanding from B_same_source_full to B_all_source_full.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if admitting worlds from newly compatible sources never creates extra certificate loss.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: No expansion universe creates a robust-impossible certificate on a truth-reachable node or a robust-reachable certificate on a truth-unreachable node.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any violation is an implementation/theory failure.

theoretical_expectation.restrictive_protection: a restrictive world for an already-surviving source cannot reach a node that its reference world could not reach, so it cannot destroy a B0 robust-impossible certificate
theoretical_expectation.permissive_protection: a permissive world for an already-surviving source contains that source's reference reachable set, so it cannot destroy a B0 robust-reachable certificate
theoretical_expectation.scope: these protections apply only while source identity set is fixed and added worlds are ordered by reachable-set inclusion

claim_boundary: The direction labels are set-inclusion relations among reachable sets, not value judgments about ecological realism.
A protected certificate remains conditional on the declared source set and parameter-world family.
E1/E2 are finite-set consequences; novelty is not claimed for the set theory.
The ecological contribution is the explicit condition under which reverse-impossibility reasoning is or is not robust in EOG world expansion.
stop_rules: Do not change the reachable-set inclusion definitions after scoring.
Do not reclassify incomparable worlds after seeing certificate losses.
Do not change the frozen v6 evidence anchors.
Do not choose a different source-freezing rule after scoring.
